description: Inspect and manage UniFi Network infrastructure with the unifly CLI: devices, clients, VLANs, WiFi, firewall, VPN, switch ports, site settings, and cloud fleets. Use for UniFi network configuration, monitoring, and troubleshooting, not UniFi Protect camera or recording management.
